Summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second Hollywood animated cinematic sequence. On the grass outside the pig pen, Marshal Tianpeng falls headfirst from the sky, crashing heavily and creating a huge pit, kicking up massive dust. After the dust settles, eight little pigs quickly poke their heads out from the pig pen from right to left, lying on the wooden railing and looking at the pit. The upside-down Tianpeng in the pit collapses, then rolls over and sits at the edge of the pit, covered in dirt, looking utterly bedraggled. He looks at the row of pigs, and the pigs look at him. At that moment, the helmet falls from the sky, landing at the edge of the pit, startling Tianpeng and the row of pigs. The camera language is tense, humorous, and continuous, with a total duration of 15 seconds.

Detailed Description:
Hollywood animated cinematic shot design, Pixar-quality 3D rendering, cinematic lighting, subsurface scattering, volumetric light, soft shadows, high-key bright aesthetic, humorous atmosphere.

[Shot 1] Duration 2 seconds, wide shot, level angle. On the grass outside the pig pen, Marshal Tianpeng falls headfirst from the sky, crashing heavily and creating a huge pit, kicking up massive dust. Dust bursts outward. Tianpeng is bald, with no hair and no helmet, his body inverted and stuck in the pit. If his back is partially visible during the fall, reference <Picture 3> to ensure correct rear features.
[Shot 2] Duration 2 seconds, same framing, same shot size. The dust settles. The camera rapidly pushes in to a medium shot at the pig pen. From right to left, pig heads quickly poke out from the pen — eight little pigs in total — lying on the wooden railing, squeezed together, looking toward the pit. Pig features match <Picture 4>.
[Shot 3] Duration 2 seconds, same framing, same shot size. The pigs squeeze together on the wooden railing, blinking as they look at Marshal Tianpeng. Blink frequency and timing are natural and must not be synchronized.
[Shot 4] Duration 2 seconds, medium shot, locked-off, focused on the upside-down Marshal Tianpeng. The upside-down Tianpeng in the pit collapses, then rolls over and sits at the edge of the pit, his bald head and body covered in dirt, utterly bedraggled. The camera slowly pushes in to emphasize his predicament. When his back is turned during the rollover, strictly reference <Picture 3> for the back of the bald head and rear armor.
[Shot 5] Duration 3 seconds, two-shot medium, over-the-shoulder. Tianpeng looks at the row of pigs, and the pigs look at Tianpeng. Both sides stare in silence; the pigs squeeze together on the wooden railing. The camera slowly trucks sideways, keeping both sides in frame.
[Shot 6] Duration 1 second, same framing, same shot size. The camera stops, locked-off. The pigs squeeze together on the wooden railing, blinking as they look at Marshal Tianpeng. Blink frequency and timing are natural and must not be synchronized.
[Shot 7] Duration 2 seconds, wide shot. Foreground: Marshal Tianpeng sitting on the ground with his back to the camera — strictly reference <Picture 3> to correctly display the back of his bald head and rear armor structure. Background: the row of pigs lying on the wooden railing. The helmet suddenly falls from the sky, landing at the edge of the pit with a metallic sound, startling Tianpeng and the row of pigs. The pigs collectively duck their heads, Tianpeng leans backward. The camera freezes on the moment the helmet lands.
[Shot 8] Duration 1 second, same framing, same shot size. The image freezes. After landing, the helmet bounces slightly, and dust drifts slowly downward. Marshal Tianpeng maintains his leaning-back posture, the back of his bald head and rear armor clearly visible, referencing <Picture 3>. The eight little pigs collectively duck their heads, squeezed together on the wooden railing, eyes wide open, expressions shocked. The image is still, with only dust settling slowly.

Overall Soundscape:
The whistling sound of a heavy object falling from the sky, a massive impact, dust splashing, pig grunts, the creaking of pigs squeezing the wooden railing, the friction of Tianpeng's armor as he rolls over, the metallic sound of the helmet landing and rolling, the startled squeals of the pigs, the brief lingering echo after the helmet lands, and the faint rustle of dust settling slowly. No dialogue.
